description.value: El Caracol Mexican Cafe is a sit-down Mexican restaurant located on Victoria Drive in Vancouver's Sunset neighbourhood. The Victoria Drive corridor is a well-travelled cycling route connecting south Vancouver to the city centre, making this cafe a convenient stop for riders coming from or heading toward Fraserview and Champlain Heights. As a neighbourhood cafe with regular hours, it offers a full-service dining experience in an area with relatively few comparable options.
